entries.meaning: map of reference constants (Tref, Pref, use-nasa9-cp, use-h2-cp, h2-cp-mode); unknown keys are refused; checked by `check_reference_state`
reference temperature in K; kinetics default 298.15 K, thermodynamics default 300 K; kinetics option `Tref`
reference pressure in Pa; kinetics and thermodynamics default 1e5 Pa; kinetics option `Pref`
list of species maps; required; its order fixes the species index; read by `init_species_from_yaml`
species name, the key every other block uses; required; stored in `species_names`
map from element symbol to count; the molar mass is computed from it; passed to `molar_mass`
reference heat capacity at constant volume divided by the gas constant; default 5/2; stored in `species_cref_R`
reference internal energy divided by the gas constant, in K; default 0; stored in `species_uref_R`
top-level list of reactions, one map per reaction; read by `ArrheniusOptionsImpl::from_yaml` and the other readers
reaction string; => irreversible, <=> or = reversible; required; parsed by `Reaction`
name of the rate form; each reader keeps the entries of its own type; required; compared with the reader `name()`
map of the rate parameters of one reaction entry; read as `rxn_node["rate-constant"]`
name of the saturation vapour pressure function of a nucleation or evaporation entry; required; stored in `logsvp`
Arrhenius pre-exponential factor, input in molecule, cm, s units; default 1 in internal units; converted by `convert_from`
exponent of the temperature ratio in the Arrhenius rate; default 0; stored in option `b`
activation energy divided by the gas constant, in K; default 1 K in the Arrhenius reader; stored in option `Ea_R`
evaporation diffusivity at the reference state, mol-m-s units; default 2e-5; stored in option `diff_c`
exponent of the temperature ratio in the evaporation diffusivity; default 1.75; stored in option `diff_T`
exponent of the pressure ratio in the evaporation diffusivity; default -1; stored in option `diff_P`
volume factor of the evaporation rate coefficient; default 1.8e-5; stored in option `vm`
length whose square divides the evaporation rate coefficient; default 1e-2; stored in option `diameter`
eddy diffusion coefficient on the N-1 inner faces of a column, argument of `diffusion_coefficients`
distances between neighbouring level centres on the N-1 inner faces, argument of `diffusion_coefficients`
Karush-Kuhn-Tucker; the optimality system of a constrained least-squares problem, assembled in `leastsq_kkt_impl`
compressed sparse row; the sparse-matrix layout passed to `cuda_csr_solve_cusolver`
diagonal perturbation of the KKT multiplier block in scaled units; default 0, argument of `leastsq_kkt`
flag of the table interpolation; when `extrapolate` is false, queries outside a grid take the end values
tolerance argument handed unchanged to the cuSOLVER QR solve; Python default 0, argument of `cuda_csr_solve_cusolver`
the largest difference a test accepts between a computed value and its reference; distinct from a solver's stopping tolerance
a leading axis of a call's inputs over which the call repeats the same per-cell computation independently; the species or reaction axis is last, except in `ThermoY`
